description: ρ-FREE A=3 mirror binding-ratio prediction from the q-Reeb phase. B(K)=ρ·S(K), S=Σ_λ y_λ dim_λ|Δθ_λ| (substrate-only). The RATIO B(³H)/B(³He)=S(³H)/S(³He) is ρ-INDEPENDENT (ρ cancels) ⇒ a genuine no-fit prediction: predicted 1.1173 vs AME 1.09896 (1.67%). The ABSOLUTE scale ρ stays fitted (CAL-4-gated): ρ_need(³H)=18.3455, ρ_need(³He)=18.6516 MeV/rad. NOT a closure — per-λ ρ_λ from one total binding is the underdetermined Δ_λ gate.

rho_free_ratio.note: ratio = S(³H)/S(³He); ρ cancels — no fit, no free parameter

absolute_scale_fitted.note: ρ_need = B_AME/S uses the experimental binding ⇒ CAL-4-gated (fitted); the ~1.7% spread is the universal-ρ consistency, not a derivation.
